newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil prison rebels take hundreds of hostages.
newsitem.headline: Brazil prison rebels take hundreds of hostages.

text.p: Rebellious prisoners took several hundred people hostage on Sunday at a jail in Sao Paulo state, a local news agency reported.

The prisoners at the jail in Sao Vicente took six prison guards and between 300 and 400 visiting relatives of inmates hostage, but later released one of the guards and around 100 women and children, Agencia Estado said.

Prison authorities in Sao Vicente confirmed there was a rebellion at the jail, but they declined to comment on the number of hostages, saying they were negotiating with the inmates. They said there were no dead and no injured.
The cause for the rebellion was not known and there was no attempted jailbreak, Agencia Estado said.

Prison riots are regular occurences in Brazil, where conditions are poor in notoriously overcrowded jails, according to human rights activists. Rioting inmates often demand to be transfered to other, less crowded jails.
